rules.statement: A plaintiff in a vindicatory suit must prove their own title; failure to do so results in the failure of the plaintiff's case regardless of the defendant's title.
rules.supporting_quote: In a vindicatory suit the plaintiff must prove his title. Having failed to prove his own title, he cannot rely on the weakness of the 1st defendant's title. Whatever the strength of the 1st defendant's case, if the plaintiff fails to establish his title, plaintiff's case must necessarily fail
